archetypes.name: dyn-io-parity
archetypes.rationale: Repointed many small parsers with caller-specific edge cases.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed call sites that now delegate to larch_io. Focus on duplicate-key precedence, empty-key handling, comment skipping, CR stripping, missing-file defaults, and on_error_default behavior. Compare the wrapper kwargs against the old local implementations for silent wire-format drift. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-atomic-safety
archetypes.rationale: Atomic write behavior now centralizes symlink and temp-file handling.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect larch_io.atomic_write and the session_env, clarify, plan_review, implement_dispatch, review_aggregate, and run_logs repoints. Focus on symlink refusal, stale temp cleanup, O_EXCL behavior, parent creation, temp naming, file modes, and os.replace versus shutil.move parity. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
